The review of the inbox timeline says **fix**: two things you asked for are missing.

- **No decision line:** the task log has no `decision` line, even though `doc/inbox-data.md` points to one.
- **No chat in the detail:** a row's detail only links out to the card. It doesn't show the card's chat in a right sidebar beside it.

The rest works: the computed map of the inbox's sources, the ranked rail with "Big things only" on by default, the detail opening beside the rail, and streaming with no timed polling.

There are seven small notes in the report. The two most useful:
- **New landings don't appear on their own.** Someone has to run the `Landings.mjs --append` command until a one-line change to `Server/on-landing.mjs` is made. That change is written out in the doc but not applied, because the task wasn't allowed to edit `Server/`.
- **Every shot logs a page-load error.** One file fails to load (a 404), so "smoke clean" isn't proven.

I was only given shots at 1200 and 1920, not all four widths.

The full report is [review/report.md](/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/13/session-730e8a7b/mastermind-repo-slim/inbox-data/review/report.md).
